sourceBreakdowns.basis: Exact Michigan SIGMA checkbook rows filtered to FY2024, Education, Payments to Local Units, Individuals, and Private Groups, and Payments to Local Units. The 12 accounting-period exports contain 21,406 payment rows and reconcile in integer cents to the parent total. Michigan excludes payments that are private, confidential, or protected under state or federal law.
